notes: Event -> company exposure mappings for the event-probability layer.

Point-in-time rule: never edit an active row in place. To change a mapping, set effective_to on the existing row and append a new row with effective_from set to the same timestamp. Editing in place rewrites history and breaks backtest reproducibility.
fundamental_variable must be one of core/event_probability/valuation.py FUNDAMENTAL_VARIABLES.

impact_if_yes / impact_if_no are decimal deltas on that variable (e.g. -0.06 = -6 percentage points of growth). materiality scales the impact once; it is not applied again in sensitivity or the mispricing score.
Seed rows below are illustrative and paired with the stub fixtures in research/event_market_fixtures.json. Replace them with reviewed mappings before enabling EVENT_PROB_MODE=live.

mappings.notes: Tighter China export restrictions reduce data-center revenue growth. Materiality reflects the share of revenue exposed to restricted destinations.
